added_examples.turoyo: Bas aḥna azzano, dlo meni l ḥaǧǧi Amin w lu Yusəf bə Gawwo mawtawwolle ḥa bu baytayḏi. Ḥa pis kətle tarte niše səryoye... w səmli lə səmli əšqaḏ gəd mzabannowolle laṣ ṣalḥoye, mu bayto lə nafəq. Aṯənwoli məštəriye... ač čato l aṯi məštəriye nošo. Qayəm ǧbərno hulile maṯe alfo (200 000) čiki baynoṯayna zlamat w mwaṣatte, hulile...
added_examples.translation: But we went; without my knowledge, Hajji Amin and Yusuf of the Gawwo family had settled someone in my house. A bad fellow, he has two Syriac Christian wives... And whatever I did, last year I was going to sell it to the people from Salih, he did not leave the house. Buyers had come to me... This year no buyer came, nobody. Then I was compelled, I gave him two hundred thousand; men came between us and mediated, I gave him...
added_examples.rationale: New Preterit/1 in a concrete housing dispute; baynoṯayna identifies the parties and the intervening men.
added_examples.translation_note: Project machine translation; interpretation checked against the Turoyo.

added_examples.turoyo: Xori Brahim: E ṭaye ne, mə Qarqat ne. ʕAbdəlkarim u ḥatnaṯṯe yo. W aṯən mwaṣaṭte noše fəlan, lə səmme.
added_examples.translation: Father Brahim: Yes, they are Muslims, they are from Qarqat. Abdelkarim is their son-in-law. And people came and mediated and so on; they did not do it.
added_examples.rationale: Second independent Preterit/1 with overt noše; retain emphatic ṭ alongside source t in the earlier passage.
added_examples.translation_note: Project machine translation; interpretation checked against the Turoyo.

added_examples.turoyo: Xori Brahim: Mwaṣṭiwo an nošaṯṯe. An nošaṯṯe w ahəl dəṯṯe, mwaṣṭiwonne w əzzənwo ṭəlbiwo. D ruḏ̣anwo, ubiwonne, w d lə ruḏ̣anwo, l ubiwonne.
added_examples.translation: Father Brahim: They used to send the women as intermediaries. The women and the woman's family, they used to send them as intermediaries, and they went and asked for her. If they agreed, they gave her to them, and if they did not agree, they did not give her to them.
added_examples.rationale: First Infectum-wa and sole evidence for transitive subsense 1b; the shared context also contains -nne indexing the intermediaries.
added_examples.translation_note: Project machine translation; interpretation checked against the Turoyo.
